content.title: Micron, Trade Desk, Western Digital: 2025's Big Stock Movers

content.title: AI Trade’s Next Leg Is All About Tech’s ‘Pick-and-Shovel’ Stocks
content.summary: Data storage companies dominated the S&P 500 Index in 2025, with Sandisk Corp. shares soaring almost 580% to make them the benchmark’s best performer, with Western Digital Corp. in second and Seagate Technology Holdings Plc in fourth.  Meanwhile, AI-linked power providers and cable and fiber producers such as Amphenol Corp., Corning Inc., NRG Energy Inc. and GE Vernova Inc. were among the Top 25.
